text: Farid's band are playing the Cluny on Friday at 9pm. He's on bass now, not drums. Said he'd stick me on the guest list. They've got a new singer, Niamh, who used to be in some folk group in Belfast. Farid reckons they might do a little tour in the spring if Friday goes well, maybe Manchester and Glasgow. He seemed really happy, much more than when he was stuck in the office job.
imogen lives in leith now, flat above a bakery. works at the botanic gardens doing education stuff
Astrid has her grade 7 cello recital Saturday 2pm and she's properly bricking it. Text her good luck Saturday morning.
Chantal and her husband are moving to Lisbon sometime in the spring. Nothing booked yet, just looking.
jada half marathon sun 8 nov, aiming sub 2hrs. ask how it went monday
Miriam's mum had a fall last week, she's in the Royal till at least Thursday. Miriam's back and forth every evening and looks shattered. Pop round with dinner one night this week.
Bogdan - works nights at the depot, two kids, wife is Ana, they live off Cowley Road. He's from Cluj originally.

So Malik got through to the regional final of the chess thing, it's on the 14th at half 10 in Leeds. His dad's driving him up. Really chuffed for him. He's only fourteen and he's been playing since he was six, mostly online against people in America at silly hours. His mum Adaeze says he barely sleeps the week before a tournament and goes very quiet. Message him the night before, nothing heavy, just good luck.
dong said his sister Akira is getting married in March 2027 in Osaka. whole family flying out
Hugo's play opens tomorrow evening at the Arts Theatre, 7.30. He's playing the butler, apparently a small part but he gets the last line. Need to book tickets for the Saturday matinee before they go.
Adaeze Okafor, new neighbour at number 12. Nurse at St Thomas's. Has a dog called Biscuit, a very loud beagle.
Felix wants vinyl for his birthday, specifically anything Talking Heads. Birthday is 2 December.
Pick up dry cleaning tomorrow before 10, then drop the parcel at the post office.
Rebecca's 5k was called off because of the flooding, rescheduled for sometime next month. She's annoyed, had been training since August.
Alejandro's dad passed away on Sunday. Funeral is Thursday at 11am at St Mary's. I'm going with Caroline. Must send a card before then.
caroline + reza anniversary dinner sat, 10 yrs. they're doing the place they had their first date
Siobhan Brennan - old uni friend, lives in Galway, teaches primary. Married to Aidan, two girls. Allergic to nuts.

Voice memo. Okay so Manon's choir has a concert on the 29th, 7pm, in the cathedral. She's doing a solo for the first time and was really nervous about it when I saw her. Her partner Gintaras is filming it. Remind me to message her the day before, and then ask how it went after.
Wiremu got the job at the council! Starts after Christmas. Send congrats.
Ryan's lad Mateo has his first football match Saturday morning, 9am kickoff. Ryan's more nervous than Mateo is.
niamh off to uni in sept 2027, wants to do medicine. very driven. her mum's a GP
Ethan and Moira's housewarming got cancelled, the move fell through at the last minute. They're staying at her mum's for now. Check in with them next week.
Ali mentioned his brother Reza is running the London marathon in April 2027 for a mental health charity. Should sponsor him.
Met Akira's partner finally, Nora. Lovely. She's a vet in Hackney and they've got two cats, Miso and Tofu.
Gintaras has his driving test Weds 4 Nov at 1.40pm. Third attempt. Wish him luck that morning.
Ana's starting a new job at the library on Monday. Said she's a bit anxious about the early starts.
Rebecca Jensen, Felix's sister, works in HR at the hospital. Lives in Didsbury with her girlfriend.
Book car MOT, it's due end of the month
Talked to Chantal for ages after the recital. Her daughter Jada played the flute, honestly amazing for a 9 year old. Chantal says Jada wants to audition for the junior conservatoire in the new year.
farid gig went well last night apparently, sold out. ask him for the recording
Bogdan's wife Ana is expecting, due in May. They haven't told his parents yet.
Imogen's mum turns 70 on Sunday the 8th. Big lunch at 1pm, Imogen is stressing about organising it all. Ring Imogen Saturday evening to see if she needs a hand.
miriam going to see her sister in Auckland in Feb 2027 for three weeks. hasn't seen her in 6 yrs
Hugo Moreau - lives in Clapham, works in insurance, does am dram on the side. His girlfriend Siobhan is Irish, from Cork.
Quick one: Malik won! Regional chess champion. Must get him something small, maybe a nice chess book.
Malik's dad is a taxi driver, mum works at the Co-op. Malik's the eldest of four.

Dr Haddad says Moira's knee op is the 19th at 8am. She has to be there at 7. Recovery about six weeks, so she'll miss the choir's Christmas concert on 12 December 2026, which she's gutted about. Moira's worried about not being able to drive. Remind me to call her the evening after, and maybe arrange a food rota with Ethan.
Running club Thursday at 6, then dinner.
Dong's daughter has her piano exam tomorrow afternoon. He says she's cool as a cucumber.
Aidan and Siobhan are doing the Dublin marathon together on the 26th. Their first one. Aidan's calf has been playing up though.
Wiremu's mate Mateo, the tall one, works for the rugby club as a physio. Lives in Ealing I think.
adaeze said her brother Felix (Fez) is doing standup at the Comedy Store friday 13 nov 8pm. we should all go. need to get tickets
Felix lives in Peckham, works in a bike shop, plays in a five-a-side team on Tuesdays.
Caroline's dog Rolo went missing yesterday afternoon, last seen near the park. She's in bits. Share the poster on the street WhatsApp.

Long call with Alejandro this morning. He's doing okay, considering. The funeral was hard but he said it helped seeing everyone. He's going back to work Monday but his boss said he can do half days for the first couple of weeks. His sister Manon is staying with him until the weekend. I should check in again sometime next week, maybe take him for a pint.

Ryan's band is playing the Fleece on 21 November 2026 at 8. Support slot. Ryan says they've been rehearsing every night. Doors at 7, they're on around 8.15 so don't be late. Tickets are a tenner on the door. His girlfriend Astrid is doing the merch stall and designed the t-shirts herself, so buy one. Ryan's day job is at the garage on Mill Road, he's hoping to go part time if the band picks up.
Nora mentioned she wants to do a pottery course sometime in the new year. Would make a good birthday present, her birthday's in January.
Got the dentist at 3.15 on Tuesday, then need to collect the kids.

Jada's school is doing Oliver in the spring and she's going for the Artful Dodger. Auditions soon. Chantal says she's been singing Consider Yourself round the house non stop and the neighbours have complained twice. Jada's very shy at school though, so it's a big deal she's even trying. Rehearsals would be Tuesday and Thursday after school from January, which Chantal is less excited about since she works late those days.
Reza Usman, Ali's cousin. Accountant. Lives in Bradford with his parents. Big Leeds fan.
Astrid texted, recital went fine apparently, she's relieved. Send flowers?
Uncle Gintaras is seventy next March. Family's planning something in Vilnius for 14 March 2027, maybe a long weekend. Need to check flights.

Siobhan said her husband Aidan got made redundant from the factory last Friday. They're trying to stay positive. He'd been there nineteen years. There's a meeting with the union on Monday at 10 about the payout, and he's got an interview lined up for sometime next month at a warehouse in Athlone, which is a long drive. She's looking at extra shifts. Text Siobhan tomorrow evening to see how they're doing.
Note to self: Rebecca's kid's name is Ethan, not Evan. He's 7 and mad about dinosaurs.
Manon told me Chantal and Bogdan used to be together years ago, which explains a lot.
Akira's team has the cup final on the 7th, kickoff 3pm. She's the captain this season. Tell her good luck the night before.
Imogen's partner Hugo plays rugby for the vets on Saturdays. They live in Morningside with Imogen's dad.
Nothing much from the coffee with Moira, just a catch-up. She's well.

Dong's brother Ali is moving back from Singapore after Christmas, probably January. He's been there eight years. Dong's thrilled, says their mum has already made up the spare room. Ali's got a job lined up at a bank in Canary Wharf starting 1 February 2027.
farid's mum - Mrs Haddad - is in hospital again, chest infection. he's going to see her tomorrow morning. check how she is end of week
